articles.description: After a season in which inconsistent injury messaging prompted numerous distractions, Craig Breslow said he plans to undertake a review of the Red Sox’s medical department.
articles.title: Craig Breslow says Red Sox will undertake review of medical department

articles.description: It’s been nearly two years since Triston Casas last played in a competitive game, but the oft-injured Red Sox first baseman will soon return to action in winter ball.
articles.title: Craig Breslow says oft-injured Red Sox first baseman will play winter ball

articles.description: Craig Breslow has been known as the Red Sox’s chief baseball officer since he was hired to run the club after the 2023 season, but going forward he will hold a new title.
articles.title: Red Sox boss Craig Breslow confirms he has been given new title

articles.description: Two Red Sox standouts were named Second Team All-MLB at the MLB Awards show in Las Vegas on Wednesday.
articles.title: Two Red Sox standouts earn Second Team All-MLB honors

articles.description: Walpole’s Cam Schlittler made history on Wednesday, as the Yankees ace became the 13th unanimous AL Cy Young Award winner in history.
articles.title: Walpole’s Cam Schlittler unanimously wins AL Cy Young Award

articles.description: Scott Boras, baseball’s most powerful agent, said Wednesday that he’s had extensive talks with the Red Sox, who he described as being determined to improve.
articles.title: Scott Boras on talks with Red Sox: ‘They’re building, they want to advance’

articles.description: Kristian Campbell hasn’t appeared in a big league game since June 2025, but Craig Breslow said he believes the former top Red Sox prospect still has a “world of potential.”
articles.title: Red Sox boss believes former top prospect still has ‘world of potential’

articles.description: Red Sox fans never got to know Curtis Mead after he was injured immediately following his arrival at the trade deadline, but his former boss in Washington predicted he’ll quickly become a fan favorite.
articles.title: Former Red Sox executive on Curtis Mead: ‘Boston is going to love him’

articles.description: Despite helping lead one of the most remarkable in-season turnarounds in recent memory, Red Sox manager Chad Tracy fell short in his bid for Manager of the Year honors.
articles.title: Red Sox’s Chad Tracy finishes third in AL Manager of the Year vote

articles.description: Will Trevor Story still be the Red Sox’s starting shortstop in 2027? Craig Breslow wouldn’t commit to it when pressed on Monday in Las Vegas.
articles.title: Craig Breslow open-minded about shortstop job, won’t commit to Trevor Story

articles.description: Craig Breslow provided a series of Red Sox injury updates at the GM Meetings, most notably concerning Roman Anthony and Triston Casas.
articles.title: Red Sox boss provides injury updates on Roman Anthony, Triston Casas

articles.description: Typically Craig Breslow has a clear checklist of needs to address heading into the offseason, but with capable starters at every position he said he expects to take a different approach this winter.
articles.title: ‘We’ll be opportunistic’: Red Sox boss plans to build around existing core

articles.description: Payton Tolle’s magical 2026 season does not end with the American League Rookie of the Year Award
articles.title: No Rookie of the Year Award for Payton Tolle despite magical 2026 season

articles.description: The Red Sox have officially released a veteran right-hander days after he was caught up in last week’s 40-man roster crunch.
articles.title: Red Sox release veteran reliever who was recently designated for assignment

articles.description: With a lockout looming and lingering uncertainty over the sport’s economic landscape, Craig Breslow and the Red Sox are heading into uncharted waters this offseason.
articles.title: MLB notes: Where Red Sox, Craig Breslow stand ahead of upcoming GM Meetings

articles.description: Pedro Martinez knows firsthand how damaging a protracted work stoppage can be, and Saturday at his foundation’s gala the Hall of Famer implored MLB’s owners and players to avoid a lockout.
articles.title: ‘Figure it out’: Red Sox legend implores MLB, players to avoid lockout
